entities.name: Joseph Crocé-Spinelli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Crocé-Spinelli was a French engineer, aeronaut and inventor, one of the pioneers of aviation. Along with Gaston Tissandier and Théodore Sivel, he achieved a record altitude of 8,600 metres (28,200 ft) in the gas balloon Zénith.
